definitions.gloss: to expose; to reveal; to disclose; to unmask
definitions.explanation: To bring hidden or secret information to light, especially wrongdoing, scandals, or things someone wanted to keep secret. Often implies the revelation is damaging to the person exposed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{暴露|ばくろ}された。
{元社員|もとしゃいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内部|ないぶ}{情報|じょうほう}→内部情報：27190_naibujouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{暴露|ばくろ}した。
examples.english: A former employee exposed the company's internal information.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名人|ゆうめいじん}→有名人：17812_yuumeijin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{私生活|しせいかつ}→私生活：15112_shiseikatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{暴露|ばくろ}されること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Cases of celebrities' private lives being exposed online are increasing.

notes:
USAGE:
Also used as a noun: ⟦{暴露|ばくろ}→暴露：07630_bakuro⟧ (exposure, revelation). The compound ⟦{暴露|ばくろ}→暴露：07630_bakuro⟧{本|ぼん} (exposé book) is a common collocation. Carries a stronger, more dramatic tone than ⟦{明|あ}かす→明かす：12961_akasu⟧ or ⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{暴露|ばくろ}する (to expose a secret)
- ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{暴露|ばくろ}する (to expose wrongdoing)
- ⟦{暴露|ばくろ}→暴露：07630_bakuro⟧{本|ぼん} (exposé; tell-all book)
- ⟦{暴露|ばくろ}→暴露：07630_bakuro⟧⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧ (exposé article)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{明|あ}かす→明かす：12961_akasu⟧: to reveal, to disclose — more neutral; can be used for personal confessions
- ⟦{告発|こくはつ}→告発：07999_kokuhatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to accuse, to report — focuses on formally reporting wrongdoing, often to authorities
